# Zero, a Field Guide

The zero is a placeholder. It holds the place where nothing is, so that something can be counted.

## In the classroom

Teachers draw a large circle and ask the children to carry the zero. The *children* laugh.

## In Gujarati

ગુજરાતી નિશાળમાં શૂન્ય ઉપાડો એમ કહેવાય છે.
